scenarios.name: Prompt Boundary Enforcement
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the design isolate untrusted prompts from system instructions, secrets, and tenant context?
risk_identification: Direct prompt concatenation can blur trusted and untrusted instruction boundaries.
Unredacted context can leak credentials or cross-tenant data to a model provider.
security_control_requirements: Separate system instructions, retrieved context, and user content in the model request.
Apply input and output policy checks before releasing a response.
Test prompt-exfiltration and cross-tenant injection cases.
verification_points: Architecture shows explicit trusted and untrusted prompt boundaries.
The policy pipeline redacts secrets before model invocation.
Adversarial prompt tests run in CI.

scenarios.name: Tenant-Isolated Retrieval Pipeline
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does the vector retrieval implementation enforce provenance, authorization, and deletion?
negative_indicators: 共享向量库无租户过滤
risk_identification: Missing metadata filters can retrieve another tenant's document chunks.
Incomplete deletion can retain regulated content in vectors or caches.
security_control_requirements: Attach immutable tenant, document, and ACL metadata to every vector chunk.
Require authorized metadata filters in every retrieval query.
Delete source files, chunks, embeddings, and caches through one audited workflow.
verification_points: The vector schema requires tenant and ACL metadata.
Retrieval APIs cannot omit the authorization filter.
Deletion acceptance tests cover vectors and caches.

scenarios.name: Constrained Agent Tool Gateway
scenarios.problem_scenario: Does a policy gateway authorize, validate, approve, and audit every model-requested tool call?
risk_identification: An unconstrained tool call can turn model manipulation into a real business impact.
Broad tool credentials can expand the blast radius of a single malicious request.
security_control_requirements: Route all tool calls through an allowlist and policy authorization gateway.
Validate arguments against JSON Schema and bind scoped credentials to the user intent.
Pause high-impact calls for human approval and persist a tamper-evident audit record.
verification_points: Unknown tools and malformed arguments fail closed.
High-impact tools cannot bypass human approval.
Audit records correlate prompt, user, approval, tool call, and result.
